name: ai-fullstack-learning-platform
description: AI 全栈开发工程师学习平台 —— 免费课程导航 + 学习路径 + 自测 + 进度管理

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.demo: npm run build:shared && npm run demo:data && npm run dev:demo
scripts.check:links: npm run build:shared && npm run check:links -w @aifs/api
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:shared && npm run demo:data && npm run build:demo -w @aifs/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @aifs/api && npm run build -w @aifs/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @aifs/shared && npm run test -w @aifs/api && npm run test -w @aifs/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @aifs/api && npm run typecheck -w @aifs/web
scripts.start: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @aifs/api
